owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

bookSlot(uint256).notice: User books an open slot. Simultaneously creates a session and locks USDC escrow.         Requires prior USDC approval for the session cost.

bookSlotWithPermit(uint256,uint256,uint8.notice: Same as bookSlot but uses an EIP-2612 permit signature so the user         signs once (gasless) then submits a single on-chain tx.         The permit grants exactly the session cost; if the allowance already         covers it the permit call is skipped to avoid nonce collisions.

cancelSlot(uint256).notice: Expert cancels an unbooked slot and recovers the deposit.

claimExpertReadyTimeout(uint256).notice: Non-slot sessions that reach ExpertReady but the user never confirms start         also need an escape hatch. After NO_SHOW_GRACE seconds past session creation,         the user can cancel and recover their full escrow.         (Slot-linked sessions use claimNoShow instead — this covers direct requestSession flows.)

claimNoShow(uint256).notice: User claims a no-show penalty after the grace period has elapsed.         Claimable when: slot is Booked, the session has NOT started (status is         Pending OR ExpertReady), and block.timestamp >= scheduledTime + NO_SHOW_GRACE.         C-1 FIX: ExpertReady sessions (expert accepted but user never confirmed start)         are now also covered — previously they deadlocked with no exit.         C-2 FIX: ExpertReady counts as no-show because the call never actually started.         Merely calling acceptSession does not count as "answered on time".         Effect: full session USDC refund to user; deposit split 80/20 user/platform.

claimSlotDeposit(uint256).notice: When a slot's linked session completes, the expert's deposit is returned.         Called internally from endSession when the session originated from a slot.         Because we can't easily know which slotId links to a sessionId without a         reverse mapping, we expose a separate claimSlotDeposit for the expert to         recover their deposit after session completion.

createSlot(uint32,uint32).notice: Expert creates an available time slot. Deposits 1 USDC as commitment.         The deposit is returned when the slot is completed or cancelled (if unbooked).         If the expert is a no-show, 80% of the deposit goes to the user and 20% to the platform.

getSessionRatings(uint256).notice: Returns (userScore, expertScore) for a session. 0 means not yet rated.

rateSession(uint256,uint8).notice: Rate a completed session. User rates the expert (score goes to Expert stats);         expert rates the user (stored per-session only, for display).         Score must be 1–5. Each side can rate exactly once.

requestSessionWithPermit(address,uint32,.notice: Permit variant: caller signs EIP-2612 off-chain (no gas tx), then calls this         function once. If allowance already covers the cost, permit is skipped so a         reused/stale signature never causes a revert.
